headline: Gland Pharma shares jump 4% as Q2 net profit surges 58% YoY
hook: Strongest quarter in recent quarters for Gland

modes.bear: R&D spending increased to 6% of revenue, and sustained momentum depends heavily on continued US regulatory approvals and execution in the CDMO business.
modes.bull: Net profit surged 58% YoY with EBITDA margins expanding to 27%, driven by a 31% growth in the high-margin CDMO segment and strong US product launches.
modes.simple: Gland Pharma made a lot more money this quarter than last year, driven by strong sales of injectable medicines and contract manufacturing, making investors happy.

summary: Gland Pharma reported a 23% year-on-year increase in Q2 revenue to Rs 1,834 crore, while net profit surged 58% to Rs 290.8 crore for the September 2026 quarter. The company's CDMO business grew 31%, contributing 45% to overall revenue, while the Critical Injectables business grew 18%. During the quarter, the stock touched a fresh 52-week high of Rs 3,345 following the earnings beat. Strong operational performance and regulatory approvals in the US market boosted investor confidence.
why_it_matters: Robust earnings lift pharmaceutical sector sentiment and reward Gland shareholders.
winners_losers: Gland Pharma shareholders gain / competitors affected
